requirements.quote: BIDDER shall provide a schedule for the project with the bid. This shall indicate, at a minimum, the schedule for drawings, shipment from factory, delivery at site, overall lead time to site ARO, and schedule for field works.
requirements.text: Bidder must provide a project schedule with the bid.

requirements.quote: BIDDER shall clearly indicate in a separate document any clarifications and/or deviations the BIDDER is issuing in response to the RFP and specifications. Only clarifications and deviations provided in this separate document and accepted by the PURCHASER will be consider to be part of the contract.
requirements.text: Bidder must submit clarifications or deviations in a separate document.

requirements.quote: Special Tools necessary for installation, testing and maintenance.
requirements.text: Bidder must provide special tools for installation, testing, and maintenance.

requirements.quote: Necessary drawings, instructions and test reports in the English language.
requirements.text: Bidder must provide drawings, instructions, and test reports in English.

requirements.quote: In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files.
requirements.text: Final drawings must be submitted in AutoCAD format.
Bidder must provide maintenance equipment and spare parts.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall have eighteen (18) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions with protective relay and controls, two (2) revenue meter positions, two sets of (2) 15kV isolation switches, bus VT’s, and multi-ratio CT’s as shown in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Switchgear must include specified components and configurations.

requirements.quote: Switchgear shall be Arc-resistant Type 2B. The switchgear shall meet or exceed the most conservative interpretation of standard IEEE C37.20.7.
requirements.text: Switchgear must be Arc-resistant Type 2B and meet IEEE C37.20.7.

requirements.quote: All necessary hardware for installing and testing shall be provided with Metal Clad Switchgear.
requirements.text: Bidder must provide all necessary hardware for installation and testing.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall be mounted within a fully enclosed Equipment Building (by others).
requirements.text: Switchgear must be mountable in a fully enclosed equipment building.

requirements.quote: The Metal Clad Switchgear will be connected to two (2) 13.2 kV feeders supplied by National Grid. Connection between the feeders and the switchgear will be underground cables.
requirements.text: Switchgear must connect to two 13.2 kV feeders via underground cables.

requirements.quote: Separate utility incoming Cable termination compartment is required, that allows the utility to lock.
requirements.text: Switchgear must include a lockable utility cable termination compartment.
